MQTT broker 的域名或 IP，四個選項都免費、允許匿名、不必註冊（20: Domain name or IP of the MQTT broker. All four options are free, allow anonymous access and need no registration (all four verified on real hardware 2026-08-07: the module reached TCP 1883 on every one). The default, mqttgo.io, is hosted in Taiwan and gives Taiwanese users the lowest latency. ⚠ These are fully public brokers — anyone can subscribe to the topics you publish, and other people's messages may show up in yours. Never send real data while testing, and add a random suffix to your topic. TLS ports: 8883 for mqttgo.io and the rest (mosquitto's CA-free port is 8886).

PDP 與 SIM 的「唯讀前置檢查」—— 動作前先確認這幾項都正常。⚠ 這裡刻: Read-only pre-flight checks for PDP and SIM — confirm all of these look right before doing anything. ⚠ Only queries live here on purpose: activating and deactivating PDP (AT+QIACT=1, AT+QICSGP, AT+QIDEACT) all live in the PDP Context group on the TCP/IP page. The reason is that when the same command is defined on two pages, editing one leaves the other behind — which actually happened in this project: V26.0.53 gave the TCP/IP page's APN a dropdown and a "you normally don't need this" warning, while this page's copy never caught up, so the same button gave completely different guidance on the two pages (found by the user on 2026-08-07).

To fully reset networking, use Deact PDP in the PDP Context group on the TCP/IP page — deactivating PDP tears down MQTT, HTTP, TCP and every other connection, so that global action is kept in one place instead of drifting between two copies.
